ueber.title:
Architecture,
Community
and Responsibility
ueber.paragraph1: WerkQuartier is a building group consisting of architects, specialist planners and committed people with a shared understanding of sustainable and responsible living. For the new Dietenbach urban quarter, we are applying for a plot of land to jointly develop a multi-family house that consistently pursues the quarter's guiding principles – social, ecological and sustainable. Our goal is to design high-quality living space that combines modern architecture with social interaction and long-term environmental responsibility.
ueber.paragraph2: Based on our professional backgrounds and interdisciplinary experience, we place particular emphasis on future-oriented planning and energy concepts. These include resource-saving construction methods, the use of sustainable materials, energy-efficient building technology and the integration of renewable energies. At the same time, we understand architecture not only as built space, but also as a contribution to a liveable, open and intergenerational neighbourhood with high social and ecological quality.

start.subtitle:
Modern Construction
For a Sustainable Future
start.desc: Welcome to WerkQuartier – where modern architecture, sustainable living and co-designed living spaces create a future-oriented home in the new urban quarter.
start.projektidee_desc:
WerkQuartier represents a Baugruppe initiative that brings together contemporary architecture, sustainable construction, and flexible urban living concepts within a concrete development project.
As part of the emerging Dietenbach urban district, we are realising a multi-family residential building that functions as an independent architectural component within a diverse and vibrant neighbourhood.
Rather than being understood solely as a residential structure, our project aims to contribute as a high-quality architectural piece and potential catalyst for a forward-looking urban development with strong spatial quality and a high standard of design.
start.architektur_desc: WerkQuartier is developed as a Baugruppe in which future residents actively participate in the design process. This creates flexible living and working structures that adapt to different lifestyles and needs.
start.staedtebau_title: Neighborhood Integration – embedded in Dietenbach’s urban vision
start.staedtebau_desc: The project is part of Freiburg’s new urban district development in Dietenbach. It promotes open neighborhood structures, permeable spaces, and a strong connection to the surrounding public realm.
start.nachhaltigkeit_title: Sustainable Urban Living – resource-efficient and future-oriented
start.nachhaltigkeit_desc: In alignment with Dietenbach’s ecological goals, WerkQuartier focuses on energy-efficient construction methods, durable materials, and a reduced footprint in land use and resource consumption.

projekt.title:
A Vision for
Inspired
Living
projekt.desc: WerkQuartier is applying as a building group for a site within the first development phase of Freiburg’s new Dietenbach district (Frohnholz, Plot Cluster 1). The current plan is to develop a multi-family residential building with approximately 12 to 16 owner-occupied apartments. The project is currently in the preparation and application phase. Together, we are working on the conceptual foundations for a future residential project in the new Dietenbach urban district.
projekt.bau_desc: As part of the development of the new Dietenbach district, the project is understood as a contribution to a diverse and future-oriented urban neighborhood. The focus lies on a contemporary architectural approach, sustainable construction methods, and flexible, community-oriented forms of living.
